properties.name: app.security.encryption-key
properties.description: AES-256-GCM key for stored credentials: Base64 of 32 random bytes. Set it with TDL_APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY; never commit it.

properties.name: app.security.encryption-key-previous
properties.description: Previous encryption key during a key rotation (decrypt only). Remove it after re-encrypting the credentials under Settings.

properties.name: app.notifications.base-url
properties.description: Public base URL for links in notification emails, including any context path, e.g. https://deploy.example.com/tdm.

properties.name: app.display-time-zone
properties.description: Time zone for displayed timestamps (stored in UTC), e.g. Asia/Dhaka. Empty means the server's time zone.
